name: vault.notes.edit
description: Edits one NOTE in a transaction-local document; a rejected edit leaves nothing pending.
example: await vault.notes.edit({ note_ref: note.entity_ref, edit: { kind: "whole_text", text: "# D1 test plan\n- bar: chat >= 1.00x\n- result: pass", timeout_ms: 2000, base: null } });
